== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tentacle (Japanese)|Tentacle]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67795 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(32, 14, 448, 622)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>aa670d291813289a5366525081d4d41427f565707d910126f8f21803c3cda732</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/65/Japanese-ANH-Tentacle-SWCA-67795.jpg Internet Archive item].
